      org.eclipse.jgit.lib.Repository cloneIfNotExists(String folder, String cloneUrl) throws Exception
      Clone the git repository given by cloneUrl only if is does not exist yet in folder.
      Parameters:
      folder - The folder to store the local repo.
      cloneUrl - The repository URL.
      Returns:
      The repository object (JGit library).
      Throws:
      Exception - propagated from JGit library.

    • cloneIfNotExists

      org.eclipse.jgit.lib.Repository cloneIfNotExists(String folder, String cloneUrl, String username, String token) throws Exception
      Clone the git repository given by cloneUrl only if is does not exist yet in folder.
      Parameters:
      folder - The folder to store the local repo.
      cloneUrl - The repository URL.
      username - Username used for private repository access.
      token - Personal Access Token used for private repository access.
      Returns:
      The repository object (JGit library).
      Throws:
      Exception - propagated from JGit library.
